agency.name: Office of Substance Use and Mental Health (SUMH), Utah Department of Health and Human Services

narrNote: Utah has no affiliate on NARR's official affiliate list (checked 2026-10-22). Utah licenses substance-use treatment and recovery residences through state channels rather than a NARR affiliate.
notes: SUMH is the renamed Division of Substance Abuse and Mental Health; the old dsamh.utah.gov address redirects cleanly to sumh.utah.gov. Agency phone (801) 538-3939 is published on SUMH's official contact page, which also lists the Utah Crisis Line number used in stateCrisis. USARA's usara.org redirects to utahrecovers.org; the effective URL is recorded. Utah 211 publishes 888-826-9790 on its site; the site bot-walls scripted fetches and its content was verified via browser fetch in-run. Medicaid SUD: Utah Medicaid delivers behavioral health and SUD coverage largely through county-based Prepaid Mental Health Plans / local substance abuse authorities and accountable care organizations; medicaid.utah.gov is the official member entry point (no single SUD-specific member page was verified).

peerOrgs.name: Utah Support Advocates for Recovery Awareness (USARA)

stateCrisis.name: Utah Crisis Line (Huntsman Mental Health Institute), via SUMH contact page
